scope: P2-SNOW-30 design only; no runtime implementation

precipitation_peers_preserved.reason: Precipitation relationship alone does not establish snowfall amount equivalence.

snow_leopard_topic_correction.reason: Lexical false positive; biodiversity occurrence density is not meteorological snow/ice.

implementation_requirements: Harden weather.point.snowfall as an explicit single-candidate numeric snowfall-amount forecast contract.
Keep open_meteo/snowfall as the only direct candidate; do not invent a second provider.
Guarantee consumer unit cm for the snowfall-amount path.
Model snowfall accumulation as the preceding provider runtime interval rather than not_applicable.
Preserve weather.point.weather_code and weather.point.weather_summary as separate condition semantics.
Do not route generic precipitation peers as snowfall_amount.
Remove snow_ice topic from gbif_biodiversity/occurrence_density_snow_leopard while preserving biological_hazards.
Keep coverage unknown for Open-Meteo snowfall until machine-readable routing coverage exists.
